definitions.subtype_exact: Same complete subtype set; order/duplicates ignored; independent of primary.
definitions.both_axes: Primary AND complete subtype set both equal.
definitions.primary_kappa: Unweighted Cohen kappa, nominal primary categories.
definitions.missing: Invalid/no-error outputs excluded, not counted as disagreements; valid is format validity, not clinical correctness.

limitations: Agreement is not accuracy; no adjudicated human gold standard is used.
Same question occurs across student models/stages; no independent-case confidence intervals.
Historical GPT snapshot unknown; model settings/providers differ across grading models.
Input prediction extraction defects and inconsistent few-shot labels were previously audited and preserved for this experiment.
Common-case selection excludes cases invalid for any rater; pairwise denominators and missingness are reported separately.
This comparison contains no new human-workbook merge and no new model calls.
